question.text: Given that $X \sim \textrm{Bernoulli}\left(\dfrac 23\right),$ compute $P(X = 1).$
question.explanation:
If $X \sim \textrm{Bernoulli}(p),$ then $X$ has the following probability mass function:

\[ f(x) = \begin{cases} p, & x=1 \\[3pt] 1-p, & x=0 \end{cases} \]

Here, $X \sim \textrm{Bernoulli}\left(\dfrac 23\right),$ so the distribution of $X$ in this case is

\[ f(x) = \begin{cases} \dfrac 23, & x=1 \\[3pt] \dfrac 13, & x=0. \end{cases} \]

Therefore, \[ P(X = 1) = f(1) = \dfrac 23. \]

question.text: Given that $X\sim \textrm{Bernoulli}(0.5)$ and $Y \sim \textrm{Bernoulli}(0.3)$ are independent, calculate $P(X=0 \, \cap \, Y=0).$
question.explanation:
Using the multiplication law for independent events, we have

\[ \begin{align*} P(X=0 \, \cap \, Y=0) &= P(X=0) \cdot P(Y=0). \end{align*} \]

Now, since $X\sim \textrm{Bernoulli}(0.5),$ we have

\[ P(X=1) = 0.5, \quad P(X=0) = 0.5, \]

and since $Y \sim \textrm{Bernoulli}(0.3),$ we have

\[ P(Y=1)=0.3, \quad P(Y=0)=0.7. \]

Therefore,

\[ \begin{align*} P(X=0 \, \cap \, Y=0) &= P(X=0) \cdot P(Y=0) \\[3pt] &= 0.5 \cdot 0.7 \\[3pt] &= 0.35. \end{align*} \]

question.text: Given that $X\sim \textrm{Bernoulli}(0.6)$ and $Y \sim \textrm{Bernoulli}(0.6)$ are independent, calculate $P(X=1 \, \cup \, Y=0).$
question.explanation:
By the addition law, we have

\[ \begin{align*} P(X=1 \, \cup \, Y=0) &= P(X=1) + P(Y=0) - P(X=1 \, \cap \, Y=0). \end{align*} \]

Using the multiplication law for independent events, we have

\[ \begin{align*} P(X=1 \, \cap \, Y=0) &= P(X=1) \cdot P(Y=0). \end{align*} \]

Therefore,

\[ \begin{align*} P(X=1 \, \cup \, Y=0) &= P(X=1) + P(Y=0) - P(X=1) \cdot P(Y=0). \end{align*} \]

Now, since $X\sim \textrm{Bernoulli}(0.6),$ we have

\[ P(X=1) = 0.6, \quad P(X=0) = 0.4, \]

and since $Y \sim \textrm{Bernoulli}(0.6),$ we have

\[ P(Y=1)=0.6, \quad P(Y=0)=0.4. \]

Therefore,

\[ \begin{align*} P(X=1 \, \cup \, Y=0) &= P(X=1) + P(Y=0) - P(X=1) \cdot P(Y=0) \\[3pt] &= 0.6 + 0.4 - 0.6 \cdot 0.4 \\[3pt] &= 1 - 0.24 \\[3pt] &= 0.76. \end{align*} \]
